title.narrative: Human Resources Support to the International Trade Centre (ITC)

description.narrative: The International Trade Centre (ITC) works towards creating ‘trade impact for good’ and is a development agency fully dedicated to supporting the internationalization of small and medium-sized enterprises, supporting developing countries and economies in transition. Established in 1964, the International Trade Centre is the joint agency of the World Trade Organization and the United Nations.\nUNOPS offers human resources support services to the ITC.\n
